digest.component_or_area: snapshot compaction and orphan event handling
propositions: Natural fold enumeration retires and cites orphaned (un-cited pre-snapshot) events without replaying their effects, erasing orphan signals and converting repairable damage to silent loss.
Fold must exclude fsck-defined orphans from retirement and source_event_uuids citation by anchoring to the latest prior snapshot in the fold set; first fold excludes nothing.
Routing parity: repair_or_plan must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE type gating enforced by fsck --repair, blocking whole-ticket rebuild on human-triage orphans.
Defer guard prevents pre-snapshot foldable events from folding while their governing snapshot is young, avoiding silent burial under a new pre-snapshot snapshot.
